page.overview:
What is Field of Celebrant?

The Field of Celebrant was a large flat area between the river Celebrant to the north, Limlight to the south, Misty Mountains to the west and Anduin river to the east.

The Field was the location of the Battle of the Field of Celebrant, between the Easterling Balchoth, Gondor and the Éothéod. It was not historically part of Gondor, Rohan or the Elven realm of Lothlórien.
